A small place on the web

September 9, 2026 · Sample post

I wanted a place to write things down. A page with my name on it, a few links, and room for ideas that need more than a short message.

I’ve always liked personal websites that feel like someone’s notebook. You can read what they’re working on, follow a link, and leave with something interesting to think about.

So that’s the plan here: write when there’s something worth writing about, keep the pages easy to read, and let the collection grow slowly.

A small beginning is enough.
